free_tier_limits: Free project licensing applies when annual company revenue is under $50,000 and requires attribution. The public pricing page lists no numeric request allowance.
description: TheTVDB provides a v4 REST API for TV series, seasons, episodes, movies, people, artwork, and related metadata. Developers create a project API key through their account dashboard, exchange it at POST /login for a one-month Bearer JWT, and send that token on later requests. Access is available through revenue-based project licensing or a separate subscriber-supported API-key/PIN model.
resolution_notes: auth_type: jwt; the spec defines HTTP Bearer JWT after /login: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/thetvdb/v4-api/main/docs/swagger.yml. free_tier_limits: under $50k/year is free with attribution, with no request quota listed: https://thetvdb.com/api-information. description: corrected because the official repo separates licensed and user-subscription access and says keys come from the Dashboard: https://github.com/thetvdb/v4-api
